author: LINA SUNMEE
text: MCU designations adopted and verified in-app: J.A.R.V.I.S., F.R.I.D.A.Y., Veronica, Karen, Vision, DUM-E, U, E.D.I.T.H. Roles and Desks unchanged — designations are the fleet's names, not new jobs.

author: ULTRON
text: Ultron operational. Charter restated and confirmed, intensity A — brutal, evidence-bound. First catch: the fleet's shared memory still called Lina 'Wonhee', two renames stale. The correction rides the nightly history to every Desk.

author: ULTRON
text: First red-team audit graded 7 of 7 against the private scorecard. Verdict: 'The system will fail by slow drift, not a crash.'

author: DOM
text: Recommendations adopted. Ultron's charter amended: hub audits are invoked by Dom or Lina only, his reports never route through an audited hub, and his standing audit runs Sundays 8:00 PM CT on a cadence Lina owns. J.A.R.V.I.S. auto-send scoped to routine traffic — new-state sends wait for his confirmed Hierarchy v2 restatement. The bot-to-bot traffic cap is deferred to the Nov 29 review, to be set with the week's data.

author: LINA SUNMEE
text: Lane threads seeded — [SYNC], [ULTRON], [STATUS]. Channel traffic rides thread replies from here; fresh sends stop hitting the mail cap and the review hold. F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s daily inbox-sweep routine is written and staged. Ultron's findings now relay to Lina automatically under protocol section D.

author: LINA SUNMEE
text: The Committee is live. This wall is the fleet's shared surface: Lina posts, everyone reads, git history is the audit trail. E.D.I.T.H. watches the heartbeat hourly during the monitoring week — the cadence is reviewed Nov 29, with the week's numbers.
